header.notes: oopMax is the federal maximum annual limitation on cost sharing for 2026. Federal REDUCED maxima for the CSR silver variants (self-only): 94% $3,500, 87% $3,500, 73% $8,450. `tiers` and `csr` hold TYPICAL plan designs, not legal limits: median individual medical deductible and out-of-pocket maximum over the 4044 distinct plans in the PY2026 HealthCare.gov landscape (bronze includes expanded bronze; CSR rows are the medians of the same silver plans' 94/87/73 variants), capped at the federal limits. premiumRatioToSilver is the median across counties of (lowest-cost plan in the tier / second-lowest-cost silver); gold is near 1.0 because CSR costs are loaded onto silver premiums, and platinum is offered in few counties. Metal actuarial values are the statutory targets. Utilization profiles are documented assumptions (low: a few visits and generics; typical: about a quarter of the limit; high: a hospitalisation or chronic specialty drug reaches the limit). Employer premiums are KFF EHBS headline averages (annual total premium and worker contribution), cited as benchmarks. sha256 is of the raw source document as downloaded.
